answer: The ridge schedule is applied in dawn and falcon publishes each instalment. A payout is split thus 60% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1700 identities would post 4829 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
